lessons/l-greet.title: Saying hello and goodbye
lessons/l-greet.body:
# Les salutations
In French, the greeting you choose depends on the time of day and how well you know the person.

bonjour = hello / good morning
bonsoir = good evening
salut = hi / bye (informal)
au revoir = goodbye
à bientôt = see you soon
bonne journée = have a good day

## Formal or informal?
- Use **vous** with strangers, elders and at work.
- Use **tu** with friends, family and children.
- When in doubt, start with *vous*.

Comment allez-vous ? = How are you? (formal)
Ça va ? = How's it going? (informal)
Ça va bien, merci. = I'm fine, thanks.

lessons/l-intro.title: Introducing yourself
lessons/l-intro.body:
# Je me présente
je m'appelle Joyce = my name is Joyce
j'habite à Toronto = I live in Toronto
je suis étudiant / étudiante = I am a student
je parle anglais et un peu français = I speak English and a little French
enchanté / enchantée = nice to meet you

## Your turn
Write three to five sentences about yourself using the phrases above. You'll hand them in as this week's writing assignment.

assignments/a-quiz1.title: Quiz: greetings
assignments/a-quiz1.instructions: Choose the best answer for each question. You get one attempt, and your score appears right away.

assignments/a-write1.title: Write about yourself
assignments/a-write1.instructions: Write 3–5 sentences introducing yourself in French: your name, where you live, what you do and which languages you speak. Use the phrases from the lesson "Introducing yourself".
